dedupe_keys.name: mosaicos de imagens de satelite dos estados e do distrito federal 1985 a 2017

description: Mosaicos de Imagens de Satélite dos Estados e do Distrito Federal (1985 a 2017) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). Mosaico de imagens dos satélites Landsat 4, 5 e 8 por Unidade da Federação (Estados e Distrito Federal) do Brasil de 1985, 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015 e 2017 - de acordo com a disponibilidade de imagens com baixa cobertura de nuvens. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are uso da terra, uso do solo, imagem de satélite, pivô central, Landsat. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
